author: Mr_Mushroom99
body:
Hi Again, I probably shouldn't appeal again but, I am very sad right now. 

I swear I've learned my lesson enough. I am just so sad about not going on in the mornings. I wake up early at 6:00 am to get on my computer and play on avicus. But then I remember I can't. Its so sad inside me. When i am writing this i was crying. 
Whenever I go on another server everyone hates me. Except when i used to go on this server the community was amazing, it was nice, it was helpful. I have ban evaded 7 times now. feel free to ban deathsyris. I just can't go without playing. I have an account generator so I can generate alts. I could generate a new account each day and play without getting detected but I won't. Because whenever i see my old friends I can't say it's actually me. I have to stay quiet. It's such a sad feeling. This was my server where i practiced pvp. My best server. This is by far the best server. The staff are great and players are nice. But the point is i miss all of the old times. I remember the old times everyday. I am almost heartbroken. 

I swear I've learned my lesson. I will never make excessive infractions again. My dream on this server was to help it become big and become a staff and help people, but now that dream is impossible. I want one more chance. Just one more. 

Sincerely - Paperwite

title: Ban Appeal Paperwite

replies.author: Administrafer
replies.body:
Hello,
We are not willing to appeal it as you stated you've continuously ban evaded. While honesty is appreciated, the ban policy states that if you have been caught ban evading all accounts affiliated with your IP will be permanently banned (with no chance of appeal).

Thanks.
